steps.title: Label PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Label a 0.2 mL RNase‑free PCR tube (Thermo Fisher AM12230) for each sample.

steps.title: Prepare 72 °C incubator
steps.instruction: Set a thermocycler or incubator to 72 °C and keep ready.

steps.title: Thaw RNA samples
steps.instruction: Thaw total‑RNA extracts on ice (as described in dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bp6xmrfn).

steps.title: Make 10X Reaction Buffer (RB)
steps.instruction: On ice, for each sample prepare 1 µL RB consisting of 19 µL 10X Lysis Buffer (Takara #634888) + 1 µL RNase Inhibitor (Takara #2313A). Vortex, spin down, avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Assemble first‑strand reaction
steps.instruction: In each labeled PCR tube add 9.5 µL RNA, 1 µL RB, and 1 µL of an unspecified component (often nuclease‑free water) to reach 10.5 µL total; adjust volume with nuclease‑free water as needed. For single‑cell samples use ≤5 µL total RNA. Record exact volumes.

steps.title: Add SMART‑seq primer
steps.instruction: Place tubes on ice and add 1 µL SMART‑seq CDS Primer II A (12 µM, Takara #634888). If fewer than 17 PCR cycles are planned, add 2 µL instead and keep total volume constant by omitting the later water addition.

steps.title: Add water and mix
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL nuclease‑free water (total volume now 12.5 µL). Mix gently by vortex, spin down.

steps.title: Denature at 72 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 72 °C for 3 min, then place on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: Prepare first‑strand Master Mix
steps.instruction: While the samples cool, on ice prepare a Master Mix (+10 % extra) per sample: 4 µL 5X Ultra Low First‑Strand Buffer (Takara #634888), 1 µL SMART‑seq v4 Oligonucleotide (46 µM, Takara #634888), 0.5 µL RNase Inhibitor (Takara #2313A). Mix gently.

steps.title: Add reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL SMARTScribe Reverse Transcriptase (Takara #634888) to each Master Mix (including the +10 % extra). Mix gently, vortex briefly, spin down.

steps.title: Combine Master Mix with RNA
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL of the prepared Master Mix to each 12.5 µL RNA‑primer mixture (final volume 20 µL). Pipette mix and give a short spin.

steps.title: First‑strand incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate in a pre‑heated thermocycler with lid: 42 °C for 1 min 30 s, then 70 °C for 10 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Mastermix
steps.instruction: Make a PCR Mastermix (+10 % extra) per sample: 25 µL 2X SeqAmp PCR Buffer (Takara #638526), 1 µL PCR Primer II A (12 µM, Takara #634888), 3 µL nuclease‑free water, 1 µL SeqAmp DNA Polymerase (Takara #638504). Mix gently (finger‑flick) and spin down.

steps.title: Add PCR Mastermix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL PCR Mastermix to each 20 µL first‑strand reaction (total 50 µL). Mix by pipetting, spin down.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run the following program on a thermocycler: 95 °C 1 min; then 18 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 30 s, 68 °C 3 min; then 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C forever. (Note: alternative cycle numbers are used for some species.)

steps.title: First bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 22.5 µL AMPure XP beads to each 50 µL PCR product (total 72.5 µL). Pipette up/down ≥10 times, vortex, incubate RT 8 min for binding.

steps.title: Magnetic separation – first wash
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnetic rack, discard 72.5 µL supernatant while beads remain. Add 200 µL fresh 80 % ethanol (do not disturb beads), discard ~100 µL. Repeat ethanol wash once more (total 2 washes). Briefly spin, return to magnet for 30 s, remove remaining ethanol with a 10 µL pipette.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave beads at room temperature for ~2 min until matte, non‑shiny, but not cracked.

steps.title: Elute purified cDNA
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL Elution Buffer to dried beads, remove from magnet, pipet‑mix to resuspend, incubate RT 2 min, brief spin, place on magnet 1 min until clear. Transfer supernatant (purified cDNA) to new RNase‑free PCR tubes.

steps.title: Aliquot for Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Immediately set aside an aliquot for Agilent Bioanalyzer analysis to avoid freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Label tubes and store purified cDNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assess cDNA quality
steps.instruction: Run an Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit (Agilent #5067‑4626) according to the manufacturer’s protocol and evaluate the electropherogram for appropriate size distribution and minimal primer dimers.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure cDNA concentration (e.g., by Bioanalyzer or Qubit) and record values for downstream calculations.

steps.title: Normalize cDNA to 30 pg/µL
steps.instruction: Dilute each purified cDNA sample to 30 pg/µL in Elution Buffer (minimum 1 µL cDNA, final volume 5 µL).

steps.title: Prepare Nextera XT reagents
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a PCR thermocycler to 55 °C (lid 100 °C). Aliquot ATM and NT reagents (5 µL per sample) from the Nextera XT kit (Illumina #FC‑131‑1096) into separate tubes for multi‑pipetting.

steps.title: Tagmentation with modifications
steps.instruction: Follow the Nextera XT manual, but start tagmentation with 5 µL of the 30 pg/µL cDNA. Replace all 280 × g, 20 °C, 1 min centrifuge steps with a short spin in a tabletop mini‑centrifuge.

steps.title: Post‑tagment storage
steps.instruction: Store tagmented samples at 4 °C for up to 2 days or proceed directly to bead purification.

steps.title: Prepare AMPure beads for library cleanup
steps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP bead stock thoroughly. Aliquot 30 µL beads per sample (plus extra). Bring bead aliquots to RT for ≥30 min, vortex again. Prepare fresh 80 % ethanol (400 µL per sample).

steps.title: Bind indexed library to beads
steps.instruction: Spin down each 50 µL indexed library sample, add 30 µL AMPure XP beads, mix by pipetting, vortex for 2 min, incubate RT 5 min for binding.

steps.title: Magnetic wash – library
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnetic rack, discard 80 µL supernatant. Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol, discard ~100 µL; repeat ethanol wash once (total 2 washes). Brief spin, return to magnet 30 s, remove remaining ethanol with a 10 µL pipette.

steps.title: Air‑dry library beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry beads at RT for ~5 min until matte, non‑shiny.

steps.title: Elute purified library
steps.instruction: Add 52.5 µL Resuspension Buffer (Nextera XT kit) to dried beads, remove from magnet, pipet‑mix, vortex 2 min, brief spin, incubate RT 2 min, brief spin, place on magnet 2 min until clear.

steps.title: Collect final library
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL clear supernatant (purified library) to RNase‑free PCR tubes.

steps.title: Aliquot library for Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Immediately set aside an aliquot for Bioanalyzer analysis to avoid freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Store libraries
steps.instruction: Label and store libraries at –20 °C until sequencing.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Run Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit (or DNA 7500 Kit) per manufacturer’s protocol. Note presence of primer‑dimers; if present, perform an additional bead cleanup (0.7 : 1 bead‑to‑sample ratio).

steps.title: Calculate library molarity
steps.instruction: Determine ng/µL from Bioanalyzer, obtain average fragment length (bp), then compute nM DNA = [ng/µL] × 10⁶ / (660 × fragment length).

steps.title: Normalize and pool libraries
steps.instruction: Normalize each library to equal molarity (e.g., ≥0.5 nM), pool them, and verify the pool with a Bioanalyzer run before sequencing.
